heroTitle: Operators Who Discovered, Developed, and Deliver
heroDescription: Our management team combines decades of operational experience with specific expertise in the Cobalt camp. This isn't their first project - it's the culmination of careers spent in processing and exploration.
heroList2: Proven track record of discovery and development
memberStory1: 28+ years in hydrometallurgical engineering. Designed and operated plants processing 3M oz silver annually. Architect of Re-2Ox process. Led TTL acquisition and upgrade. Holds patents in metal recovery. Previously technical lead at major operations globally.
memberStory2: Chartered Professional Accountant specializing in mining sector. CFO for multiple TSX-V listed companies. Expertise in flow-through financings, M&A transactions, and regulatory compliance. Key role in TTL acquisition financing.
memberStory3: 13 years with Kirkland Lake Gold including resource modeling for Macassa Mine. Led exploration program that discovered Castle East. Expert in Cobalt camp's vein systems. Published research on camp geology. Instrumental in expanding resource from 2M to 7.5M oz.
memberStory4: 15+ years in mining operations and corporate development. Former COO of Gilla Inc. Expertise in permitting and First Nations relations. Oversees community engagement and regulatory affairs.
memberStory5: 20+ years in mining sector governance. Specialist in TSX-V compliance and continuous disclosure. Manages shareholder communications and board administration. Extensive experience with junior mining regulatory requirements.
